sentences.en: The incongruity between his words and actions is confusing.
sentences.zh: 他言行不一的不和谐让他很困惑。

sentences.en: There's an incongruity in the design; the modern furniture doesn't match the old building.
sentences.zh: 设计里有种不协调，现代家具和老建筑不太搭。

sentences.en: The joke relied on a sudden incongruity that made people laugh out loud.
sentences.zh: 那个笑话突然来了个不和谐之处，让大家笑出了声。

senses.zh: 不协调，不和谐；不一致；不适合，不相称 - 不协调的东西

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（不）+congruity（一致，和谐）→不协调，不相称
